snapshot.baseline_source: Git tree and blobs read by git ls-tree and git cat-file at pinned_commit; independent of the current index/worktree content.
snapshot.working_tree_hashes: Current bytes hashed only for .gitattributes, .gitignore, and AGENTS.md; contents were not emitted.
snapshot.claim_boundary: This file records static source snapshot measurements only; no runtime behavior is claimed or tested.

pinned_path_hashes.selection_rule: Tracked paths at the pinned commit in any templates/ directory; paths with example/case path tokens; all skills/*/references trees (broader reference baseline); image extensions png/jpg/jpeg/webp/svg/gif; and evals/cases.json.

count_method.utf8_chars_including_newlines: Length after UTF-8 decoding; stored newline characters are counted.
count_method.splitlines: Python str.splitlines() count; summed per unique file, with each file counted once within a representative set.
